text:
Liz_Sales: Hey team — AcmePay wants to run a BYO CloudHSM POC. Top asks: 90-day rotation, strict no-key-access (customer-managed keys), dual-custodian requirement, and separate billing for HSM hours. Can we confirm feasibility + what needs to go in the SOW? @Mike_SE @Ana_CryptoOps

Mike_SE: We can support CloudHSM via our KMS integration. Two patterns: 1) envelope encryption where customer KEK lives in CloudHSM and we never see raw key material, or 2) we run a wrap/unwrap flow if customer delegates. Need crypto to confirm rotation automation constraints.

Ana_CryptoOps: Confirmed — envelope encryption in CloudHSM is our recommended path for zero-access. We can automate rotation by generating new data keys and rotating the KEK in CloudHSM, but the actual key ceremony depends on customer's CloudHSM admin. If customer insists on an in-person key ceremony, that becomes manual.

Liz_Sales: Customer says zero-access only. Also asked about network requirements (CloudHSM endpoints), and whether Redwood will accept BYO-HSM billing passthrough or if we need to charge separately.

David_SRE: We support VPC peering and PrivateLink for the Dedicated environment. Latency impact to serving should be small (typically 2–8ms extra). We'll need the customer's allowed IP ranges and (optionally) a dedicated SG. We'll post exact CIDR list in a moment.

Rebecca_Legal: For contract language, we need an explicit 'Customer retains key ownership' clause and a 'No escrow/no access by Redwood' line. Also confirm logging: we can log key rotation metadata (timestamps, key IDs) but must not store KEKs or plaintext.

Mike_SE: On pricing: HSM hours are passthrough in most quotes. Our SOW usually includes an "HSM integration" line (one-time) + per-hour HSM usage billed at cost + ops for rotation ceremonies if manual. @Liz_Sales we should propose both: automated rotation included vs manual ceremony as billable.

Liz_Sales: Customer asked that rotation be part of the POC (no surprise fees). Can ops estimate expected effort and a one-line flat fee for the POC?

Ana_CryptoOps: For automated 90-day rotation with no manual ceremony: automation work is small. Estimate for POC: one-time integration 4h, automation scripting 3h, monitoring + 1h. Ongoing ops: ~0.5h per rotation if everything is automated. If they require in-person ceremony -> add 6h per ceremony + travel/booking. For a 90-day schedule, manual would be pricey.

John_Acme (external): We prefer fully automated. We'll provide CloudHSM admin access for the initial setup and will not share KEKs. Also sending over our security questionnaire now.

Mike_SE: Got it. Please drop the SSQ link and I'll start the cryptography section. Quick sample config we'll include in SSQ answers:

```
# sample KMS section for AcmePay POC
kms_provider: aws-cloudhsm
access_model: customer_managed
rotation_schedule: cron(0 0 1 */3 ? *)  # every 3 months
retention_policy: no_key_escrow
```

David_SRE: Ticket created for network work. For CloudHSM endpoints in us-east-1 we need outbound to these ranges (draft): 52.92.0.0/14, 3.208.0.0/12, and some AWS internal ranges. I'll attach the full list to the ticket.

DeployBot: POC-4321 created: "BYO-HSM onboarding runbook" — Assignee: Mike_SE — https://redwood.atlassian.io/browse/POC-4321

Ana_CryptoOps: One more important ops detail: if customer requires strict rotation with no rollback (i.e., once KEK rotated, old KEK cannot be used), we need a 48-hour maintenance window and a coordination policy. Without rollback we have to update caches and invalidate all sessions immediately. That increases risk and needs to be spelled out in the SOW.

Rebecca_Legal: Noted. Legal prefers to include a "Rotation Lock" appendix describing risk and responsibilities. Also asking Product for a fallback SLA paragraph in case rotation causes service disruption.

Liz_Sales: Action items — Mike: fill SSQ cryptography answers and attach sample config; Ana: add SOW line item for rotation ops + estimate (automated vs manual); David: paste exact network CIDRs in POC-4321; Rebecca: propose contract language for "Customer-managed keys" + Rotation Lock appendix. Target dates: SOW draft by 2026-03-30, POC kickoff 2026-04-15.

Mike_SE: Working on SSQ now. Will ping when draft is in the ticket.

David_SRE: Posted CIDRs to POC-4321. Also added a short runbook snippet for PrivateLink setup and SG rules.

Ana_CryptoOps: For completeness — recommend adding a short test harness to verify key rotation end-to-end during POC: generate test data key, rotate KEK, verify decrypt with new key only. I can provide the harness (2–3h).

Liz_Sales: Perfect. John, does that timeline + approach work for you?

John_Acme (external): :thumbsup: Yes. We'll prep the CloudHSM account and send access details by COB next week.

Rebecca_Legal: I'll drop a contract redline draft into the ticket by EOD 2026-03-29.

Liz_Sales: Thanks all — will follow up with a short summary and calendar invites.
